name: Lead
what_is: A toxic heavy metal environmental contaminant causing neurological and reproductive damage.
why_botia: Lead can cross the placenta, and the developing nervous system is especially sensitive. Studies have observed later pubertal development in girls, but that is an association — not a proven effect of lead.
can_1: Flag food types historically prone to lead contamination.
can_2: Explain prenatal and childhood susceptibility. Individual exposure is measured with a blood lead test; a food label cannot tell you someone's blood lead level.
cannot_1: Detect the exact lead concentration from scanned label text alone.
cannot_2: Determine if lead migrated from packaging materials.
